Wait, the trex, velociraptor and Styracosaurus have default poses??? We've only gotten rips of the dinosaurs in an already posed state so I'm surprised to see them aside from the raptor from the prototype who was already in a default pose.

@Radassic The data is like this in the game files. I don't know why only 3 of them have a default pose while the others use the first animation frame as default pose. Maybe the developers wanted to do armature based animation in the first place but then switched to vertex animation midway through because of technical issues or similar reasons.

@lordofdragons Oh, understood. Bit disappointed that we only have the Trex, Stego, Raptor and the Styrac in a default pose although I could just simply download the models and try my best at making a default pose for them all. 

Also did you attempt at getting the dinosaur models seen in the only prototype found from Warpath? I'm thinking they might have some default pose from when they might've used armature based animations.

@Radassic From what I read the ones with default pose are the ones also seen in the prototype. So I assume these had been the first ones they made to get the game mechanics working. Thus I doubt there are any more files around containing default poses for the other dinosaurs as they did not exist back then.

@lordofdragons Yeah, but the Stegosaur is an outlier since it isn't playable in the only prototype thats been discovered soo far. Probably coming from a further build and ended up being the last dino to have an armature. The other dinos, well a default pose doesn't exist for them so, people would have to manually make one.
Actually the stegosaurs model didn't even exist yet except for the prototypes announcer sound files saying its name.
